finding: The study found that a lower fetoplacental ratio (FPR) was an independent predictor of both postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) and neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission.
mod_finding: The study found that women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage had heavier placentas and lower fetoplacental ratios, suggesting a potential association between these factors and mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Recorded as part of the fetoplacental ratio
